about.title: How Sumbong works
about.intro: Sumbong lets residents of Cabanatuan City report problems in public places so they get seen and reach the office that can fix them.

steps.pending_review: A BetterCabanatuan volunteer checks the location and type, and blurs faces and plate numbers in the photos.
steps.published: The report appears on the public map. Anyone can add a “Me too”.
steps.forwarded: Volunteers send a batch of reports to the responsible office (City Engineer’s Office, CELCOR, DPWH, City ENRO or the barangay) through its official channel, usually a letter to the Mayor’s Office.
steps.resolved: When the problem is fixed, volunteers mark it resolved. If it isn’t really fixed, you can reopen it within 30 days.

about.unofficial: Sumbong is a volunteer project, not an official City Government system. Sending a report here is not the same as filing an official complaint, but volunteers file it with the right office for you.
about.emergency: For emergencies (live wires, flooding with people in danger, fires) call CDRRMO at 0908-881-1010 right away.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: BetterCabanatuan collects only what it needs to get reported problems fixed, under the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

sections.heading: What we collect
items: The report itself: location, type, answers, description and photos. Location data inside photos is removed when you upload them.
Your email address, only if you choose to give it, or your account email if you are signed in.
Salted, one-way hashes of your IP address and a random browser id, used only to stop spam. We never store your raw IP address.

sections.heading: Who sees what
items: Before a volunteer reviews it, only volunteers and you can see your report.
After review, the report, location and cleared photos are public. Volunteers pixelate faces, plate numbers and names first.
Responsible offices receive the public parts of the report in a letter. They never receive your email address.
Your email address is never shown publicly or given to offices.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
items: Contact details: deleted 90 days after the problem is marked fixed, or 30 days after a report is rejected.
The de-identified public report stays on the map as a public record.

sections.heading: Services we use
items: Supabase (database and photo storage), Cloudflare (hosting and spam protection) and Resend (email). They process data only on our behalf.

sections.heading: Your rights
items: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or object to its processing. Email our Data Protection Officer below and include your report code.

privacy.npc: You may also file a complaint with the National Privacy Commission (privacy.gov.ph).
